cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(CompilerIDE VERSION 1.0 LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# Required for Qt signals/slots (runs moc automatically)
set(CMAKE_AUTOMOC ON)
set(CMAKE_AUTORCC ON)
set(CMAKE_AUTOUIC ON)

find_package(Qt6 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Core Widgets)

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# gals: analyser generated by GALS from grammar/compiler.gals.
# Do not edit by hand -- regenerating the grammar overwrites everything here,
# except Semantico.{h,cpp}, which is where the semantic actions are written,
# and src/semantic, which is plain hand written code.
# Run tools/galsgen.py to rebuild the parser tables after editing the grammar.
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
add_library(gals STATIC
    src/gals/Constants.cpp
    src/gals/Lexico.cpp
    src/gals/Sintatico.cpp
    src/gals/Semantico.cpp
    src/semantic/symboltable.cpp
)
target_include_directories(gals PUBLIC src/gals src/semantic)

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# compiler-ide: Qt front end plus the bridge that drives the analyser.
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
add_executable(compiler-ide
    src/main.cpp
    src/ide/mainwindow.h
    src/ide/mainwindow.cpp
    src/ide/codeeditor.h
    src/ide/codeeditor.cpp
    src/compiler/compiler.h
    src/compiler/compiler.cpp
)

target_include_directories(compiler-ide PRIVATE src/ide src/compiler)
target_link_libraries(compiler-ide PRIVATE Qt6::Widgets gals)

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# compiler-cli: same bridge without the GUI, so the sample programs in tests/
# can be compiled from a script. See tests/run_tests.sh.
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
add_executable(compiler-cli
    src/cli/main.cpp
    src/compiler/compiler.cpp
)

target_include_directories(compiler-cli PRIVATE src/compiler)
target_link_libraries(compiler-cli PRIVATE Qt6::Core gals)
